messages:
Nina (content): Quick sync: plan to launch our OSS refapp 'benchlab' next month. Need a launch post, short benchmark narrative, demo tutorial, webinar, and a lead-routing plan. Who's in? :wave:
Omar (growth): In. Suggest 3-week build, 1-week promotion. Webinar gated for registrants, replay gated too (we can test).
Rita (devrel): I'll own the repo updates and a 12-minute demo. Want to make the tutorial a 5-minute 'get going' so folks can run it in 1 command.
Theo (design): I'll draft a landing hero + two social assets (X and LinkedIn). Need final headline + CTA.
Priya (analytics): I'll own tracking and event taxonomy. We should capture deployment_intent (hosted/dedicated/private) and initial_model_choice. Also plan UTM scheme.
Nina (content): Draft hero lines: A) "Benchlab: realistic inference benchmarks + a developer refapp" B) "Measure latency, cost, and quality—run Benchlab locally." Which lands better?
Omar (growth): B is punchier. For inbound routing: register -> HubSpot list 'benchlab_launch_2024'; high-intent question on form: "Are you evaluating enterprise deployment? (yes/no)" leads to SDR queue.
Rita (devrel): Tutorial should include a one-line Docker run and a curl example. Example to include in README:
```
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 redwood/benchlab:0.1.0 && 
curl -X POST localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"Explain KV cache"}'
```
Theo (design): Love the code snippet. I'll do a monospace block and a tiny gif for the hero showing a request->response. Two CTAs: "Try locally" (GitHub) and "Register" (webinar).
Nina (content): Assets list: blog launch post (me), benchmark story (Omar + Rita), webinar page (Omar), repo README & quickstart (Rita), slides (Rita + Nina), social copy (Theo + Nina).
Omar (growth): Promotion plan: announcement in community channels, targeted X posts, partner newsletters, paid LinkedIn for enterprise audiences for 1 week. Also schedule demo invites for registrants who select "enterprise".
Priya (analytics): UTM pattern: utm_source=benchlab, utm_medium=social|email|partner, utm_campaign=benchlab_q3. I'll add hidden fields: original_source and deployment_interest. Also recommend tracking 'run_local_success' event from README quickstart (simple image ping).
Rita (devrel): For the benchmark narrative: compare Benchlab default config vs a cloud hosted endpoint at 1k token context, show p50/p95 tail latencies and tokens/sec. Will publish CSV and include small chart.
Theo (design): Headline A/B: "Run Benchlab in 60s" vs "Measure real-world inference performance". I'll mock both.
Nina (content): We should A/B both hero headline and subcopy. I'll prepare two short intros for the launch post: one technical (benchmarks + how-to) and one product (why Benchlab matters for teams).
Omar (growth): Registration flow: minimal fields (email, company, deployment_interest). Add a one-question qualifier to route leads. Zapier to HubSpot mapping: tag = benchlab_launch_2024.
deploy-bot: deploy_notice: staging landing deployed to https://staging.redwood.ai/benchlab-launch at 2024-07-01T14:00:00Z
Priya (analytics): Plan an experiment: 50% replay gated vs 50% open to test lead capture vs reach. We'll compare email signups and convert rate to demo requests.
Rita (devrel): Also want an interactive notebook for folks who prefer Colab. I'll add a minimal Colab link to the README.
Theo (design): I'll export social assets with two formats: short (X) and long (LinkedIn). Also prepare an email hero png for announcement.
Nina (content): Timeline: drafts due Wed, PRs by Thu, staging landing up Fri. Webinar scheduled for 2024-07-18 16:00 UTC. Check-in Friday 10am PT.
Omar (growth): I'll set up the HubSpot list and the registration page this week. Will include UTM defaults and add Zap to trigger confirmation email + calendar invite.
Priya (analytics): I'll share the tracking doc and event list before Thursday. Also will create a dashboard to monitor p50/p95 metrics we'll publish.
Rita (devrel): I'll open the README PR today with the Docker example and the quick benchmark script.
Theo (design): Will push hero comps to Figma by EOD tomorrow.
Nina (content): Final ask: keep social hooks metric-driven. e.g., "Benchlab shows 2.5x lower tail latency with caching enabled" — get me numbers from Rita so we can use a clear stat.
Omar (growth): Noted. I'll coordinate paid targeting and community seeding.
Nina (content): Thanks team — I'll drop the launch brief and add owners. :raised_hands:
